children: Full House Resorts entered into Amendment No. 1 with the City of Waukegan to modify the Development and Host Community Agreement for the American Place casino project. The amendment extends the permanent facility's construction completion deadline to February 17, 2029, with operations to begin within three months of completion. It also allows the company to retain and use the temporary casino structure for five years after the permanent casino opens and revises certain project details to match current design plans. All other terms of the original agreement remain in effect.
